question: How close can a location-and-context xG model get to Understat's, with what Gold carries? (CLAUDE.md §8 #3)
citation: features built from the Gold snapshot exported 2026-09-20T13:41:36+00:00, matches 2024-08-15 to 2026-09-19 (3,733 matches, 94,034 shots)

penalties.note: Not modelled: every penalty is taken from one spot, and Understat gives each the same xG. The constant a penalty would get is the conversion rate before the hold-out.

holdout.missing_from_gold: Gold carries no last_action — the action before the shot (cross, through ball, rebound), which Understat parses and its model uses. Part 1 has it in Silver as last_action; it is not in Gold's fact_shots. Every gap to Understat below includes what that column would explain (CLAUDE.md §5, L10).
